name: models
required_value: aed_sedflux, aed_oxygen, aed_carbon, aed_organic_matter, aed_nitrogen, aed_phosphorus, aed_silica, aed_phytoplankton
enables: all rows in the parameter table
note: all listed modules must be active; aed_silica only needed for diatom Si; aed_carbon only needed if P adsorption uses pH

name: aed_sedflux/sedflux_model
note: activates the zoned constant sediment-flux block

name: aed_sed_const2d/n_zones
note: must be >= number of active_zones; index in the param table = zone number

name: aed_sed_const2d/active_zones
note: maps model benthic zones to the flux vectors

name: aed_oxygen/Fsed_oxy_variable
note: without this link the module uses its own scalar aed_oxygen/Fsed_oxy and the zoned value is ignored

name: aed_nitrogen/Fsed_amm_variable
note: without this link the module uses its own scalar aed_nitrogen/Fsed_amm

name: aed_nitrogen/Fsed_nit_variable
note: without this link the module uses its own scalar aed_nitrogen/Fsed_nit

name: aed_phosphorus/Fsed_frp_variable
note: without this link the module uses its own scalar aed_phosphorus/Fsed_frp

name: aed_nitrogen/nitrif_reactant_variable
note: enables O2 limitation of nitrification and O2 dependence of the NH4 sediment flux; rnitrif/theta_nitrif still act without it

name: aed_nitrogen/oxy_lim
note: selects the O2-limitation formulation used with knitrif

name: aed_phosphorus/phosphorus_reactant_variable
note: enables the redox/O2 control of FRP sediment release (the anoxic P-release switch); fsed_frp still applied without it

name: aed_organic_matter/dom_miner_oxy_reactant_var
note: sets use_oxy=T so mineralisation/hydrolysis carry an O2 half-saturation term; rates and theta still act without it

name: aed_phosphorus/simPO4Adsorption
note: master switch for P sorption dynamics

name: aed_phosphorus/PO4AdsorptionModel
note: picks which sorption parameters are live

name: aed_phosphorus/ads_use_external_tss
note: or set po4sorption_target_variable to a particle pool; with no sorbent the sorption params do nothing

name: aed_phytoplankton/num_phytos
note: must be >= number of groups

name: aed_phytoplankton/the_phytos
note: column numbers in aed_phyto_pars.csv; their order sets the index (1=cyano

name: aed_phytoplankton/dbase
note: group parameter database file

name: aed_phytoplankton/settling
note: _MOB_OFF_=0 / _MOB_CONST_=1 use w_p directly; _MOB_STOKES_=3 / _MOB_MOTILE_=4 compute sinking from cell density and ignore w_p

name: aed_phytoplankton/si_uptake_target_variable
note: requires aed_silica active; without a Si source diatom Si uptake is inert

name: aed_phytoplankton/n1_uptake_target_variable | n2_uptake_target_variable | p1_uptake_target_variable | do_uptake_target_variable
note: OXY_oxy
column8: non-empty by default; keep set so K_N / K_P / R_growth actually draw down DIN

name: phyto/fT_Method
note: =0 disables temperature limitation; example CSV has diatom=0 so its T params are inert until set to 1

name: phyto/lightModel
note: =0 uses I_K (no photoinhibition); =1 uses I_S instead

name: phyto/simDINUptake
note: enables DIN uptake limitation

name: phyto/simINDynamics
note: =0 or 1 uses fixed X_ncon instead of the dynamic internal-N quota params

name: phyto/simDIPUptake
note: enables DIP uptake limitation

name: phyto/simIPDynamics
note: =0 or 1 uses fixed X_pcon instead

name: phyto/simSiUptake
note: diatom only; example CSV has this =0 for every group
